notes.subject: בעיניו יקחנו
notes.rationale: KJV: 'o e swara ka meso ya gagwe' (Behemoth e bona letšhoro) kgahlanong le potšišo ya go swara (ASV/JPS/BSB): na o ka mo swara a lebelela?

notes.subject: go Yobo
notes.rationale: Potšišo ya retoriki ya Yahwe go Yobo ka matla a Begemote

notes.subject: ינקב אף
notes.rationale: go lebanya nko — goba go hlaga nko; tsela ya go swara phoofolo ka nko

translation: Na ba ka mo swara a lebelela ⟨ka⟩ meso ya gagwe, goba ba ka lebanya nko ya gagwe ka dithebe?
